title: casting a Result with as does not consume it; the cast expression is still discarded
notes: specification/failures.mdx:136: 'A Result MUST be treated as a must-use value. A source program MUST NOT silently discard a Result without returning, matching, transforming, inspecting, or unwrapping it.' specification/type-system.mdx:56: 'An ignored Result MUST be a compile error.' `as` is a forwarding position: it changes the type the checker sees and nothing else, so the value the statement discards is still the Result the call produced, and the diagnostic belongs at that producer. REVIEW-fable-1.md F1 measured this exact program COMPILING, EMITTING AND RUNNING on the Go fork with zero diagnostics: the checked value was discarded at runtime, which is the loss the rule exists to prevent. The fork's unbound must-consume rule fired only when an expression statement's own expression typed as Result or Promise, so every container and operator position was invisible to it. The forwarding direction is 07-must-consume/a-satisfies-expression-forwards-its-result: the same climb that refuses this program accepts one where the assertion's value is consumed.
